# Isometric feature grid: six services

The isometric-feature-grid recipe: up to six labelled isometric tiles on a 3x2 grid under a title, for service overviews and architecture diagrams.

- Type: Isometric feature grid
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 7 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s09-isometric-feature-grid.mp4`](../videos/s09-isometric-feature-grid.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Make a 7 second 16:9 service overview for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, using the isometric-feature-grid style: the title "Websites, social media, email, ads and automation" over six tiles: Strategy, Websites, Social media, Email, Ads, Automation. Link the wording to claims.json. Logo in the corner (assets/magnifito-logo.svg). Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #d8c6b4, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, green #8acf31 sparingly, Geist from fonts/. English on screen.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s09-isometric-feature-grid
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s09-isometric-feature-grid/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
